pages.title: A Pocketful of Potions
pages.text: Drink a filled Flask containing real potion effects.

pages.title: A Pocketful of Potions
pages.text: Take a prepared effect with you.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Explore Herbal Infusion and the Brewing Cauldron: compatible potions can be combined in a Flask. An empty Flask does not count.

pages.title: Combine potions
pages.text: A Flask is made through the Brewing Cauldron using three supported potions and Herbal Infusion. It is separate from the tea Jug.

pages.title: Protect against magic
pages.text: Wear a Witch Hat or Top Hat in the head slot. Current configuration determines its magic protection; an accessory's appearance does not establish its armor function.
